'''Farnel Outpost''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Balmorran resistance]] outpost in the [[Bugtown]] region of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was originally a scientific lab that was part of the Farnel Research Facility, but was overtaken by [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] after the facility was damaged by bombing. The Republic eventually drove out the Colicoids and established their command post there.
